mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate increase above 0.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates for equity valuation, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of a tight labor market (UNRATE below 4.5%) and strong industrial production (INDPRO above 103.0) signals robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE < 4.5 AND INDPRO > 103.0), or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) increases the risk of stagflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are negative when HOUST is above 1300.0 in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO below 100.0) signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 100.0), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong retail sales (RSAFS above 460,000 million) and rising housing starts (HOUST above 1300.0) signals robust consumer and housing demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (RSAFS > 460000 AND HOUST > 1300.0), or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE below 4.5%) signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE < 4.5), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
